title: Later-Month Family Relief Amount - TRICARE Reserve Select Accounting Note
content:
**Accounting note - TRICARE Premium-Based Plans, TRICARE Reserve Select.** The later-month family relief is nothing: only days after the plan's termination date are counted, nothing is relieved for them per day, nothing is posted now, and the result is rounded to the cent.

- **The adjustment worked from.** Every coverage-type adjustment billed for the latest-billed month, over the days those adjustments cover, ending on the last day of the month.
- **Month concerned.** The latest-billed month, the coverage month of the plan's monthly bill with the latest due date. The relief arises only where the latest-billed month is a later month than the most recently paid month (the coverage month of the bill that the latest posted premium payment on the plan settles); where the two are the same month the relief is 0.00.
- **Assembly.** The later-month family relief figured is the number of relieved days, from the first day counted through the last day of the month, multiplied by the daily amount withdrawn; what is posted is the part of it posted now, rounded to the cent once, at the end, and never less than zero.

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Most recently paid month | June |
| Latest-billed month | July, a later month |
| Adjustment bills for July | 240.65, covering all 31 days |
| Plan's termination date | 20 July |
| Days counted | 21 to 31 July, the days after the termination date |
| Relieved per day | nothing |
| Later-Month Family Relief | 0.00 |

Had July's bill been the most recently paid month's own bill, the relief would likewise be 0.00.
